adql: SELECT TOP 10 s.source_id, s.ra, s.dec, s.phot_g_mean_mag, a.teff_gspphot, a.teff_gspphot_lower, a.teff_gspphot_upper, a.radius_flame, a.radius_flame_lower, a.radius_flame_upper, a.lum_flame*1000000 AS lum_flame, a.lum_flame_lower*1000000 AS lum_flame_lower, a.lum_flame_upper*1000000 AS lum_flame_upper, a.mass_flame, a.mass_flame_lower, a.mass_flame_upper, a.teff_msc1, a.teff_msc1_lower, a.teff_msc1_upper FROM gaia_dr3_source AS s LEFT OUTER JOIN gaia_dr3_astrophys_param AS a ON s.source_id = a.source_id WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',s.ra,s.dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',269.44850,4.73942,0.00083)) ORDER BY s.phot_g_mean_mag, s.source_id
